info.title: Onio API
info.description: Read and change your Onio wishlists and wishes from your own tools.

accessToken.description: A personal access token from your Onio profile. It starts with `onio_pat_`.

status.description: The app shows `draft` as Private, `published` as Published and `archived` as Archived.

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to get the next page. `null` on the last page.

url.description: The share link. Anyone with it can view the wishlist.
The product link as the owner entered it.

status.description: The app shows `draft` as Private. A `published` wish is visible and has no label. `archived` is not used yet.

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to get the next page. `null` on the last page.

UpdateWishlist.description: Send only the fields to change. `null` clears an optional field.

imageUrl.description: A link to an image. Must start with `http://` or `https://`.
A link to an image. Must start with `http://` or `https://`.

UpdateWish.description: Send only the fields to change. `null` clears an optional field.
